def factor_tail_asym_vol_ema_regime(df):
    """Asymmetric volatility with volume regime confirmation using active EMA-based volume classifier."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    down_ret = np.minimum(ret, 0.0)
    up_ret = np.maximum(ret, 0.0)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_weight = np.clip(vol_ratio.fillna(1.0), 0.5, 2.0)
    down_var = (down_ret ** 2 * vol_weight).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    up_var = (up_ret ** 2 * vol_weight).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    ratio = down_var / up_var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio)
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_tail_asym_vol_ema_regime")
